transcript.title: Weekly round-up
transcript.text: Hello, I'm Nova, the Ventryx AI presenter. This is your weekly market round-up for the week ending Friday 6 November.

transcript.title: Markets this week
transcript.text: Here's how the markets closed the week. The S&P 500 finished down 2.7 per cent. The tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 was down 4.9 per cent, and here in London the FTSE 100 ended down 0.5 per cent. Bitcoin was down 3.0 per cent over seven days.

transcript.title: Biggest movers
transcript.text: Among the hundred big US stocks we track, the top riser was Airbnb, up 15.6 per cent, followed by First Solar and Booking Holdings Inc. Common St. At the other end, Marvell Technology fell 28.1 per cent, with Datadog and Dell also lower.

transcript.title: In the headlines
transcript.text: In the news on Airbnb, Motley Fool ran the headline: Airbnb: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors.

transcript.title: In the headlines
transcript.text: In the news on Marvell Technology, Motley Fool ran the headline: Intel, Arm, and Marvell Have Each Been Cut in Half Since June. Only 1 Is a Stock I'd Buy Now..

transcript.title: Momentum top 5
transcript.text: On the Ventryx momentum list, this month's five are Micron Technology, Dell, Marvell Technology, Intel and Advanced Micro Devices. All five are holding their places for now. The next swap is on Monday 30 November.

transcript.title: Crypto top 5
transcript.text: In crypto, our experimental top five are NEAR Protocol, Zcash, Arbitrum, Uniswap and Monero, with Bitcoin 4 per cent above its two-hundred-day average.

transcript.title: Next week
transcript.text: Looking ahead to the week of Monday 9 November. Results are due from Berkshire Hathaway Inc. New on Monday; Cisco Systems and Applied Materials on Thursday. And on the prediction market Polymarket, the question "Will Bitcoin dip to $74,000 November 2-8?" is trading at about 8 per cent yes.

transcript.title: That's the week
transcript.text: That's your round-up. Remember, this is research, not financial advice. I'm Nova. See you next Sunday.
